title: Staff Modifier Effects
text: Each installed modifier applies once to spells cast by that staff, without changing crystals in the grid or adding per-cast mana cost. Iron improves damage or effect level; clocks delay instant effects and extend existing delays; light microcores add holy magic; spiritual crystals add infusion.

The rules match spell writing, combining modifiers before resolving effects. Holy magic does not multiply repeatedly, and repeated infusion does not duplicate bonus saturation or resistance. Dissociation, construction and dark breath retain their own modifier rules.
